name: Unified Authority Vocabulary
description: Define the canonical terms: principal, actor, delegate, capability, grant, receipt, evidence, policy, decision, approval, revocation, escalation. All subsystems use the same authority language.
purpose: All subsystems use the same authority language.
acceptanceCriteria: Every authority term has a single canonical definition across all subsystems.
Vocabulary is published as a schema in docs/json/omp/schemas/authority-vocabulary.json
No subsystem defines its own conflicting authority terminology.
All code references use the canonical vocabulary types from a shared module.
